content_sections.heading: RITES Senior Manager (Mech.)- Bulk Material Handling Expert Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.rites_limited_gurgaon_across_india: Senior Manager (Mech.)- Bulk Material Handling Expert

Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering / Technology in Mechanical / Production / Production & Industrial / Manufacturing / Mechanical / Railways / Mechatronics & Automobile or any of the above combinations.

content_sections.heading: RITES Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. CP/17/26 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RITES notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering / Technology in Mechanical / Production / Production& Industrial / Manufacturing / Mechanical / Railways/ Mechatronics & Automobile or any of the above combinations in part or whole. Experience: Minimum of 06 years’ experience in designing and optimizing bulk material handling systems. Upper age limit: 40 years (as on 2 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC-NCL 3, PwBD 10 Other conditions: Selected candidates shall be liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements. Medical fitness as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances @ 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act. Appointment shall be purely on contract basis initially for a period of one year, extendable until completion of the assignment.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online. Last date to pay the fee: 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will RITES Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Test Interview Written Test: 125 objective type questions carrying one mark each for duration of 2.5 Hours. Interview: weightage distribution - Written Test 60%, Interview 40%.

content_sections.heading: RITES Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates belonging to PwBD Category are eligible for a compensatory time of 50 minutes.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications along with mark sheets Percentage Conversion Document EWS/ SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Certificate Proof of Identity & Address PAN Card Proof of each period of experience claimed

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Interested candidates fulfilling eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website, http://www.rites.com. Note down the generated Registration No. Fill up required details under the Fill/ Modify Application Form and upload all documents under the Upload Document section. Make online payment under the Make Payment section and download final application form. Send it on or before 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Posts not reserved for SC / ST / PwD category, candidates from such category will also have to make payment of full fees. The fee charged from candidates belonging to SC / ST / PwD category will be refunded later upon participation in further selection process.
